name: Investigate Codebase
description: Systematically explores and documents a codebase to understand its structure, patterns, and key components. Creates a mental map for future development work.

variables.name: focusArea
variables.description: Specific area or question to investigate (e.g., 'authentication flow', 'data models', 'API endpoints')

tasks.description: Map out the directory structure and key files

prompt.template:
Explore the codebase structure at {{rootPath}}:

1. List top-level directories and their apparent purpose
2. Identify key configuration files (package.json, tsconfig.json, etc.)
3. Find the main entry points
4. Locate test directories
5. Identify any documentation

Focus area: {{focusArea}}

Create a mental map of how the codebase is organized.

tasks.description: Understand external dependencies and their purpose

prompt.template:
Analyze the project dependencies:

1. Read package.json to see dependencies
2. Identify key frameworks/libraries
3. Note dev dependencies for tooling
4. Check for any workspace/monorepo setup

Understand what tools and libraries the project relies on.

tasks.description: Trace the main code flows related to the focus area

prompt.template:
Trace the key code flows for: {{focusArea}}

1. Find entry points related to this area
2. Follow imports to understand dependencies
3. Identify key classes/functions
4. Note data structures used
5. Find where side effects happen (I/O, state changes)

Build understanding of how this part of the code works.

Summarize your investigation findings:

1. Create a brief document (or memo) with:
   - Project overview
   - Key directories and their purpose
   - Important files and entry points
   - Main patterns/conventions used
   - Specific findings about: {{focusArea}}
   - Recommendations for working with this codebase

This summary will help with future development tasks.
